static_traits.name: Liu Ke
static_traits.family_status: Has two children with his wife,家庭成员经常一起露营
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with teammates are strained because of his excessive focus on winning; family can provide support but his self-report shows limited understanding of the extent of his negative thinking
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness;no similar psychological issues in the past;has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,条理较好,能识do not并描述自身情绪与想法;合作度高;情绪基调略显挫败但具备Reflection与改变意愿

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得如果我的业余棒球队have not赢,那整个比赛就是在浪费时间和精力.这种想法导致我感到失望和Depression.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize negative thinking patterns have affected my overall enjoyment of activities and increased life stress, so I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, after the team experienced repeated losses, the client began forming the evaluation standard 'only winning counts', gradually attending only to victories and ignoring the positive aspects of matches; this mindset became more rigid over time.

Holding relatively high expectations for team performance, believing this increases their own pressure, thereby affecting relationships with teammates and the enjoyment of leisure experiences such as weekend camping.

core_beliefs: Only winning has value; losing is wasting time and effort
My effort only has meaning when victory is achieved

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果比赛have not赢,那么我所有的时间与努力就毫Meaninglessness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises expectations for oneself and the team, repeatedly focuses on losses after games and uses winning/losing as the sole evaluation standard
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这场比赛白费了,我not该来

special_situations.event: Before or during a game during a losing streak
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果近期经常输球,那么这次也会输,努力也have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前在心理上将失败视为既定,以降低not确定带来的Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We are going to lose again this time, all of this is in vain

special_situations.event: After making a great catch in a lost game
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非整场赢,否则任何单个好表现都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or discounts positive moments, emphasizing only the losing outcome
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那次接球也not什么用,因为我们输了

special_situations.event: Recalls the team's loss while camping with family on the weekend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果比赛输了,我就without法享受其他活动的乐趣
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Fixes attention on the negatives of the competition, reducing engagement in family activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 想到输球就觉得露营也not意思

core_conflict.wish: Gains a sense of worth and recognition through victory, experiences control and achievement
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败使努力变得毫Meaninglessness,担心被视为without能或令人失望
defense_goal: 以胜负为唯一标准来保护自尊并减少对失败的Anxiety
通过贬低或Repression积极情绪避免直面失利带来的失落

object_relations.self_representation: A self-demanding competitor (one who must win)
object_relations.object_representation: Judgmental and critical others (teammates' / others' gaze)

object_relations.self_representation: 努力却被结果negate的参与者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the team loses or others emphasize the value of 'process / fun'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对过程的关注理解为在粉饰失败,认为not赢就等于浪费
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气坚定,use'应该/必须'等词,强调结果至上,negate对过程的关注.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to recall positive moments in matches (such as a brilliant catch)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 正向体验not重要,输球才决定一切
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly downplays positive emotions, evades feelings with objective narration, then immediately returns to failure topics.

manifestations: 将胜负作为唯一的意义来源,认为not赢就'浪费时间与精力'
Competition results affect the subjective sense of meaning of leisure activities such as weekend camping
After consecutive losses, focuses more on results and ignores value and connection in the process
outcomes: Declining enjoyment of life and activities
与队友Relationship tension,团队士气受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: In sessions, repeatedly judges oneself and activities by the rule 'only winning is meaningful'
语言中出现'应该/not该'的自我Demands(如'not赢就not该来')
Initially pushes away positive moments in the competition, hard to allow oneself to enjoy the moment

exception_events.target_problem: 在Losing a competition时,来访者通常会认为投入是浪费,Low mood并忽视比赛中的积极瞬间,导致对运动的享受下降.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In one competition she lost, she completed a wonderful catch in the outfield, feeling excited and proud at the moment, briefly experiencing achievement and enjoyment.
exception_events.reason: 线索:挑战not熟悉的位置并成功完成高难度动作,带来即时的掌控感与正向反馈,使注意力暂时从结果转向过程.

positive_force: Able to notice and name her own negative thinking patterns, willing to seek help
Enjoys the match process and family time, with inner resources of pleasure
Stable work functioning and family support (wife and two children)
Willing to try recording and restructuring thoughts (such as agreeing to write a thought diary)
negative_force: Black-and-white win/lose standards and excessively high expectations
negate正向经验,心理过滤并倾向预测失败
Equates winning and losing with self-worth, leading to stress and frustration
担心影响团队士气而产生自责,增加Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: After losing, defines the match as 'wasted' and experiences marked frustration
antecedent: A game against a losing streak
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief equating winning and losing with investment and worth, and catastrophic interpretations of failure
target_behavior.function: 通过贬低活动意义来逃避失败带来的without力感与not确定,寻求控制与Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: 比赛与生活的乐趣下降,Rising stress,与队友Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly predicts failure before or during games, focusing on the negative
antecedent: Thinking about past losing streaks before a match starts
Mistakes during the match or the opponent scoring
target_behavior.core_reason: 对not yet来结果的消极Anticipation与确认偏误,源于连败后形成的僵化假设
target_behavior.function: 试图通过提前预设最坏结果来降低Anxiety与not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: 注意力被负面占据,体验与发挥受损,进一步Reinforcement消极信念
